msgid: Opens your WordPress / WooCommerce site as an Eitaa mini-app, logs visitors in with their Eitaa-verified mobile number, syncs that number with any login/registration plugin and sends Eitaa messages.
Lets visitors log in with their Eitaa-verified mobile number inside the Eitaa mini-app.
Automatic (customer with WooCommerce, otherwise the site default)

Open the mini-app at full height (Android).
In full-screen mode add padding from the --tg-safe-area-inset-* and --tg-content-safe-area-inset-* variables so content is not hidden behind system bars.
Useful when your pages use swipe gestures (sliders); users can still close the app from its header.
Disable closing with a vertical swipe
Only when the cart is not empty (WooCommerce)
Light vibration on button taps, success and errors.
Shows Eitaa's back button on inner pages (goes back in history); hidden on the entry page.
Shows “Cart (n)” when the cart has items, “Continue to checkout” on the cart page and hides itself on checkout. Updated live after add-to-cart.
Used when the smart shop button has nothing to show (e.g. empty cart). Leave empty to hide the button in that case.
Leave empty to follow the user's Eitaa theme (themeParams).

Add the CSS class mw24-hide-in-eitaa to any block, menu or widget to hide it inside the mini-app, or mw24-show-in-eitaa to show it only inside the mini-app. The body gets the classes mw24-eitaa-app and mw24-eitaa-dark / mw24-eitaa-light.
CSS selectors separated by commas or new lines, e.g. #masthead, .site-footer, .whatsapp-button.

Links to your mini-app can carry a start parameter. Supported values: p123 (post or product with ID 123), cart, checkout, account, home and u:slug (or u_slug) for the routes below. Routing happens only once per session.
One per line: slug = /relative/path/, e.g. offers = /shop/offers/. Only relative paths of this site are accepted.
The token was saved, but its format looks unusual. Please double-check it in Eitaayar.
The connection was not enabled: your site address must start with https:// because Eitaa only opens secure addresses.
The connection was not enabled: please enter the app token first.
Your site address does not use HTTPS. Eitaa only opens secure (https://) addresses, so the connection cannot be enabled yet.
When disabled, the plugin adds nothing to your site and the site behaves exactly as before.
Open my site as an Eitaa mini-app
The token comes from the MW24_EITAA_APP_TOKEN constant and cannot be changed here.
A token is saved — enter a new one to replace it
Get the token from eitaayar.ir › Apps › your app. It is stored encrypted, is never shown again and is only sent to Eitaayar.
Delete the saved token? The connection will stop working.
Tip: for extra security define the token in wp-config.php: define( 'MW24_EITAA_APP_TOKEN', '...' );
Eitaa opens this URL when users start your app. It must be HTTPS and must not redirect.
Relative path of the page that opens first, e.g. / or /shop/. The parameter ?mw24_eitaa=1 is added automatically.
I have saved the entry URL as the destination address of my app in Eitaayar

Also treat visitors as mini-app users when their User-Agent or Referer contains one of the patterns below. Not reliable — Eitaa does not guarantee these values; the entry URL is the dependable method.
Signed initData older than this is rejected (auth_date check).

After the local HMAC check, also confirm the hash with eitaayar.ir/api/app/verify. Each hash can be verified once within one minute; successful results are cached. Network failures do not block logins.
Only change this when your site is behind a CDN or reverse proxy that sets the header (e.g. Cloudflare, ArvanCloud). Wrong values allow IP spoofing.
Only needed if Eitaa shows your site inside a frame (e.g. a web client). Android and desktop apps use a normal WebView.
In mini-app mode remove X-Frame-Options and send a Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors header for the domains below. Headers added by your web server cannot be removed by WordPress.
Adjust frame headers in mini-app mode
Send login and cart cookies with SameSite=None; Secure in mini-app mode so they work inside a third-party frame.
Use SameSite=None cookies in mini-app mode

The official SDK (developer.eitaa.com/eitaa-web-app.js) is printed at the very top of wp_head. Enable this only if your theme prints scripts before wp_head(): the SDK will be injected right after the opening <head> tag using output buffering.
The site is served over HTTPS
Eitaa only opens HTTPS addresses. Install an SSL certificate and switch the site address to https://.
Copy the token of your app from the Eitaayar panel and paste it in the connection settings.
Register the entry URL shown in the connection settings as the destination address of your app, then tick the confirmation box.
Turn on the connection switch in the connection settings.
Token tested with a test message
Open the mini-app once while logged in as administrator, then send a test message from Tools.
Review the detected login plugins and phone fields, then save the phone sync settings.
Choose which events should send an Eitaa message.
Everything is set up. Your site works as an Eitaa mini-app.
Register this address as the destination address of your app in Eitaayar (it must not redirect).
Eitaa has no in-app payment API. Payments are made through your own site payment gateway, exactly as in a normal browser.
No message has been sent yet.
Make sure your site opens with https://. Eitaa does not open insecure addresses.
Log in to eitaayar.ir and open Apps (برنامه). Complete the developer identity verification if you are asked to.
Click Add app and fill in the icon, title, username, description and button text.
In Destination address enter your entry URL: %s (it must not redirect, e.g. from http to https or from www to non-www).
Save the app and copy its token from Eitaayar.
In WordPress go to Eitaa Connect › Connection, paste the token, tick “Registered in Eitaayar”, enable the connection and save.
Open your app in Eitaa (Android or desktop) while logged in to WordPress as administrator — this links your own Eitaa account.
Go to Tools › Test the token and send a test message to yourself. If it arrives, everything works.
Review Login & phone sync (confirm detected plugins such as Digits) and choose your Notifications.
Optional: under your app in Eitaayar add a mini-app (برنامک) with the same address and request publication in the Eitaa mini-app center.
Important: Eitaa has no in-app payment API. Customers pay through your own site payment gateway inside the mini-app, exactly like in a browser.
When the mini-app opens, Eitaa gives the page a signed data string (initData). The plugin checks its HMAC-SHA256 signature with your token on the server.
If that Eitaa account is already linked to a user, the user is logged in at once.
Otherwise the visitor is asked to share the phone number. Eitaa signs the number too, so it is trusted without SMS codes.
The number is searched in every phone field (Digits, WooCommerce, your own fields…). The matching user is logged in, or a new account is created.
Administrators and editors are never logged in this way (unless you explicitly allow it).
Shortcode [mw24_eitaa_login] or the “Eitaa login button” block shows a login button.
CSS class mw24-hide-in-eitaa hides an element inside the mini-app; mw24-show-in-eitaa shows it only there.
Eitaa theme colors are available as CSS variables such as var(--tg-theme-bg-color) and var(--tg-theme-button-color).
Enable USB debugging on the phone.
In Eitaa settings scroll to the bottom, touch and hold the version number, release, then touch and hold it again to open the debug menu.
Connect the phone to a computer and open chrome://inspect#devices in Chrome or Edge.
Eitaa settings › Advanced › Experimental settings › enable Enable webview inspecting.
Open the mini-app, right-click and choose Inspect.
Turn on Debug mode in Tools to see the plugin's diagnostics in the console.
The page opens in Eitaa but I am not logged in.
Check that the address registered in Eitaayar is exactly the entry URL (with ?mw24_eitaa=1), that the token is correct and look at the Log page for “auth.failed” entries.
My cache plugin breaks the mini-app.
Mini-app pages are sent as private/no-cache. If your cache still serves them, exclude the cookie mw24_eitaa_app and URLs containing mw24_eitaa in the cache settings.
Eitaa only delivers to users who opened your mini-app and allowed messages. Check your message credit in Eitaayar and the Log page.
Eitaa currently runs mini-apps on Android and desktop (Windows). Your site keeps working normally for all other visitors.
What happens when I disable the plugin?
With the connection switched off nothing is added to your pages and the site behaves exactly as before. Users keep their accounts and phone numbers.
Main hooks and functions (see docs/developer-guide in the package for details):
Users are identified by the mobile number that Eitaa signs and verifies — no password or SMS code is needed.
Log users in automatically inside the mini-app
Create an account when no user owns the shared number. Username: 98XXXXXXXXXX, e-mail: 98XXXXXXXXXX@eitaa.invalid (placeholder).
Only roles without editing or administration capabilities can be selected.
Fill empty first/last names from Eitaa
Keeps the user logged in inside Eitaa with a long “remember me” cookie.
Empty = stay on the current page.

Ask for permission to send messages

Open the Eitaa dialog without the bar
Use the shortcode [mw24_eitaa_login] or the “Eitaa login button” block anywhere. Attributes: label, class, redirect, show_linked="yes".
Add the button to the My account login form
Eitaa login only works inside the mini-app.
Show a hint instead of the button
Optional direct link to your mini-app in Eitaa (from Eitaayar). Shown under the hint.

Not recommended. By default accounts that can edit posts or manage options can never log in through Eitaa. Enable only if you understand the risk: anyone with access to the linked Eitaa account could enter your admin area.
Allow privileged accounts to log in with Eitaa

Tell the plugin where other login/registration plugins keep the mobile number. When a user logs in with Eitaa, every place below is searched (in five number formats) and the verified number is written back to all of them, so Digits, WooCommerce and others recognize the same user.
Detected plugins are enabled automatically; you only need to confirm. Undetected profiles can be enabled manually.
No fixed field. Load the existing meta keys below and add the right one to the manual map.
Developers can add or update profiles with JSON files in profiles/ or the mw24_eitaa_phone_profiles filter.
Pick one or more meta keys that really exist in your database and choose the format in which each one stores the number.
Helper fields with a fixed value
Written together with the number, e.g. a country code field (+98) or a “verified” flag (1).
Meta keys found in your database
Read-only list of user meta keys with the number of rows, the share of phone-like values and a masked sample. Keys that look like phone numbers are listed first. The list is cached for 12 hours.
For plugins that keep phone numbers in their own table. Only existing tables/columns can be chosen (read with SHOW TABLES / DESCRIBE).
Read only (search users but never insert/update rows)
Select a table to see its columns. Required columns (NOT NULL without default) need a value.
Also match the number against usernames and the local part of e-mail addresses
Useful when a phone-login plugin used the number as username. Disable it if visitors can freely choose usernames on your site.
Enter a mobile number to see which user would log in and which values would be written. Nothing is changed.
Logins, registrations, messages and errors. Phone numbers are masked and the app token is never logged.
Entries older than %d days are deleted automatically.
Entries are kept until you clear the log.
Eitaa only delivers messages to users who opened your mini-app and allowed messages. The first 50,000 messages are free; more credit can be bought in Eitaayar.
The queue keeps checkout and admin screens fast; messages are sent in the background by Action Scheduler or WP-Cron.
Skip users whose signed Eitaa data says they did not allow messages.
Only message users who allowed messages
Administrators and shop managers receive admin notifications after they open the mini-app once while logged in (this links their account).
All linked administrators and shop managers
Eitaa user IDs, one per line.
For every new user, whatever the registration method.
Sent to the customer when the order moves to one of the selected statuses.
Optional: a different text for each status
Sent once when the tracking code meta of an order is filled or changed.
Order meta key where your shipping plugin stores the code, e.g. _tracking_code.
Reminds linked users who left items in their cart (checked hourly, once per cart).
Developers can change any text with the mw24_eitaa_notification_text filter.
Messages are queued and sent in the background at the queue speed set in the Event notifications tab.

For users that already have a number in one phone field but not in the others, copy it to the missing fields. Different existing numbers are never overwritten and numbers owned by another user are skipped. Runs in the background in batches of 100 users.
